messages:
Maya (CSM): Morning team — kickoff for Evergreen Health onboarding. Customer goal: replace triage FAQ system with a production LLM assistant for support triage by 2026-05-15. High level: ingest support transcripts, run evals, and rollout to 10% of traffic for 2 weeks. Need owners for: data ingestion, validation/evals, production rollout, and training materials. Can folks ack and pick owners?

Jordan (AE): Acked. I'll keep owning commercial touchpoints and renewal context. Renewal date is 2027-01-10 — low risk if onboarding goes smoothly, but flagging potential procurement delay due to SSO requirements.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): I'll take data ingestion + sandbox env. Need sample data schema and expected throughput. Also: do they want user-level PII redaction?

Maya (CSM): Thanks @Ravi — Evergreen asked for PII minimization. Sarah (CTO) prefers hashed ids only. I'll confirm exact fields today.

Kai (Onboarding Eng): I'll own validation/evals and rollout plan. Propose these success criteria: 1) <50ms 95p latency on test traffic, 2) 85% acceptable responses on our eval set, 3) no P1 incidents for 72h after 10% rollout. Thoughts?

Jordan (AE): Criteria look good. Add business metric: reduce average time to resolution by 20% on triaged tickets within 30 days of go-live.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Quick Q on sandbox creds — does Evergreen need AWS-hosted connector or on-prem ingestion? They mentioned S3 upload + webhook. If S3, we need an IAM role; if webhook, we need an endpoint and certs.

Maya (CSM): Evergreen will start with S3 push. Sarah will share bucket ARNs. Action: @Ravi open a ticket with infra once we have ARNs.

Kai (Onboarding Eng): Sharing onboarding checklist and test plan here. Sample eval command we will use for smoke tests:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST_SANDBOX_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-1","input":"summarize: <ticket>"}'
```
Replace with prod model later.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Perfect. I'll provision a sandbox key and post instructions in the ticket. Also will add a small throughput test harness (expected ~5r/s initially).

Maya (CSM): Owners so far: Jordan (commercial), Ravi (data ingestion + sandbox), Kai (validation + rollout). I'll own enablement content and training sessions with Evergreen PMs. Can each owner add one milestone and ETA?

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Milestone: sandbox ingest validated with one week of sample data. ETA: 2026-04-01.

Kai (Onboarding Eng): Milestone: eval suite passing (>=85%) and smoke rollout runbook ready. ETA: 2026-04-15.

Maya (CSM): Milestone: customer enablement + training session scheduled. ETA: 2026-04-20.

Jordan (AE): I'll coordinate exec check-in and procurement slack with Sarah. Milestone: legal + SSO scoping complete. ETA: 2026-04-10.

onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: Evergreen Onboarding — 2026-03-25 16:00 PT. Invite link: https://cal.redwood.ai/meet/abc123 :calendar:

Maya (CSM): Nice. Two quick risks: 1) SSO/procurement delays (Jordan), 2) data quality — if transcripts are heavily noisy we may miss the 85% eval target. We'll run a quick sample quality check once they share 1000 transcripts.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): I'll run basic tokenization + redaction checks as soon as sample delivered. Please ask Sarah to drop sample to s3://evergreen-onboarding/samples/1000/ with manifest.json.

Maya (CSM): Will request now. I'll also set up a weekly 30-min standup on Wednesdays to track progress. Thanks everyone — let's use this thread for quick updates and post pull requests or runbook links as they appear. :thumbsup:
